P07.title: Evaluation, Visualization & Failure Analysis
P07.reason: ROC, DET, FMR/FNMR, ERC and AU-ERC all require matcher comparison scores. No matcher exists in this workspace, and LFW ships a pair protocol but no scores. Computing these on invented scores would produce curves that look like evaluation and measure nothing.
